name: Kings County, NY
findings: Kings County has 12,651 nonprofit organizations. 3,183 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 2,586 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Kings County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 96 housing organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 33 in similar places of this size.
